replies.review: The staff were extremely rude and unfriendly. Unfortunately, the poor service made the overall experience unpleasant.
replies.reply: Thank you for telling us. This is not how we want anyone to feel at Le Vent, and we're sorry. We've talked it through with the team. If you give us another chance, your next coffee is on us.

replies.review: Der Kaffee schmeckt super, aber der Service lässt leider sehr zu wünschen übrig. Die beiden Damen an der Kasse waren extrem unfreundlich.
replies.reply: Danke für das ehrliche Feedback und schön, dass der Kaffee geschmeckt hat. Für den Umgang an der Kasse möchten wir uns entschuldigen, so soll es bei uns nicht laufen. Wir haben das im Team besprochen und freuen uns, wenn Sie uns noch eine Chance geben.

replies.review: Lütfen işletme sahibi iletişime geçebilir mi? Çalışanlar tarafından çocuk gibi azarlandık.
replies.reply: Merhaba, yorumunuz için teşekkür ederiz ve yaşadıklarınız için özür dileriz. Böyle bir davranış kabul edilemez. Sizinle doğrudan konuşmak isteriz, lütfen bize mesaj gönderin.

learn.title: What the AI just did
lines: It read your three newest critical reviews, in three languages.
It answered in your voice: thank, apologise, say what changes, invite back.
Next time: open the review, paste it into any AI assistant, ask for a reply with those four parts.
